verdict.rationale: Gmail's own API offers a registrable push-notification watch that notifies the developer's backend server when a mailbox changes, so a programmatic consumer can subscribe to events. The evidence covers only generic mailbox-change events and does not describe the HTTP delivery mechanism or payload, so full coverage is not shown. Missing for 10: documentation of the callback delivery format and transport, granular event types beyond 'mailbox changes', watch renewal and lifecycle details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: The Gmail API provides server push notifications that let you watch for changes to Gmail mailboxes.
Whenever a mailbox changes, the Gmail API notifies your backend server application.
Set up or update a push notification watch on the given user mailbox.
